top_signals.name: Chanel Cruise 2027 debut in Biarritz (Matthieu Blazy)
top_signals.evidence: Matthieu Blazy staged his first Chanel Cruise collection April 28 at the Art Deco seafront casino in Biarritz, the town where Gabrielle Chanel opened her first couture house in 1915. Collection titled 'Sous le Salon la Plage,' built around 1920s Chanel sportswear/workwear/sailor codes plus a personal mermaid motif: a reworked 1926 little black dress opened the show, sailor-stripe quarter-zip sweaters and Basque-linen-inspired stripe fabrics ran through the middle, and beaded mermaid gowns in aquamarine and orange with fishtail hems closed it. Corroborated across seven independent editorial outlets (WWD, The Impression, Our Culture, AnOther, nss magazine, W Magazine, Harper's Bazaar Arabia, The Zoe Report, TheFashionSpot) with consistent reporting of date, venue, title, and key looks.
